note: Test-owned negative controls for the pirunner experiment. Each mutation replaces text that must occur exactly once in the named file (relative to loopadmin/), the bridge is rebuilt in the copy, and the named test runs with -tags pirunner. A kill needs a FAIL of that test whose output contains the named assertion; build failures, timeouts, skips and zero-selected runs are invalid, never kills. The control is the positive control: it is planted first and must be killed, or the harness is broken and no mutation verdict counts.
